name: vision_ocr_ctc
title: A CRNN text-line recogniser: custom collate, CTC loss over log-probabilities, greedy decoding and a character error rate
origin: domain-vision round 2: the OCR shape, whose correct `F.log_softmax` in front of `nn.CTCLoss` is the exact pairing MLV401 calls a defect for CrossEntropyLoss - a false-positive trap the rule set has to pass

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer and no split in this project
nothing is fitted on anything here
the training loader is built with shuffle=True
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
eval_transform() contains only Grayscale, ToTensor and Normalize - the ColorJitter lives in train_transform() and reaches the training loader alone
same - the two pipelines are separate factories and only the training one augments
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of the training step
optimizer.step() follows loss.backward() every batch
backward() precedes clip_grad_norm_() which precedes step()
the only no_grad region is the decorated validate(), which contains no backward()
the running loss accumulates loss.item() * batch size
OneCycleLR is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() runs inside the batch loop
clip_grad_norm_() runs between backward() and step()
validate() calls model.eval() before the loop and model.train() on the way out
validate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator
the character error rate is computed on decoded strings, after log_probs.argmax(dim=2) has already turned frames into classes
no ranking metric is computed anywhere

THE TRAP: F.log_softmax in front of nn.CTCLoss is the required pairing, not the MLV401 defect. CTC consumes log-probabilities and normalises nothing itself; CrossEntropyLoss is the loss that applies log-softmax internally, and it is not used here
the classifier head returns raw logits and the module contains no softmax at all
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the model is moved with .to(device) and every batch tensor is moved inside both loops
pick_device() checks torch.cuda.is_available()
seed_everything() seeds random, numpy, torch and torch.cuda
there is no sklearn split and no random_split in this project - train/ and val/ are separate directories on disk
ConvBlock, BidirectionalLSTM and CRNN all call super().__init__() first
the convolutional stack is wrapped in nn.ModuleList, not a plain list
there is no Keras model in this project
there is no Keras layer and no from_logits= anywhere
the checkpoint saves model.state_dict() and optimizer.state_dict(), never the module

unsupported.why: LABEL CORRECTED in hardening round 2: MLV403 is not a built rule - it carries the status **later** in docs/ISSUE_RULES.md section 1 - so a label for it can never be satisfied and can never be violated. `analyzer/tests/accuracy/test_accuracy.py::test_every_labelled_code_is_a_real_rule` rejects one, and this row turned that shipped test red. The observation is kept verbatim here so the row can be restored the day the rule ships. Original verdict `forbidden`, original note: there is no NLLLoss in this project; CTCLoss is a different contract
